items.title: Pay outstanding invoice for tree planting (payment reminder)
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie die offene Summe bis zum 04.12.2026.
items.computation: The letter prints a fixed calendar date for payment: 'bis zum 04.12.2026'. This is a company (not an authority) payment reminder, so no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies; the date is taken as printed. 2026-12-04 is a Friday, a normal business day in NW, so no weekend/holiday shift is needed.

warnings: This is a routine payment reminder from a garden centre for a service (6 fruit trees planted on 22.10.2026); the IBAN DE67 3705 0198 0005 5828 20 is a validly formed German IBAN with bank code 37050198, but a valid IBAN does not prove ownership — confirm against any earlier invoice before paying if this is the first time you see this account.

There is no Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung (legal remedy instruction) on this letter, as expected for a private company's payment reminder, not an administrative decision; no einspruch/widerspruch/klage applies.

If you already paid the original invoice before receiving this reminder, the letter itself asks you to simply disregard it ('bitten Sie, die Erinnerung zu ignorieren'), so check your bank records before paying again.
